title: PRAY THIS VIOLENT PRAYER AND YOUR LIFE CANNOT REMAIN THE SAME
text: Before you proceed to read this word, I want you to understand something. This is not just another message. The spirit of God has laid this upon my heart with urgency. Somebody connected to you is at the edge of giving up. They are one step away from abandoning their faith, their vision, their marriage, their calling. Before the sun sets today, you must share this word with them. There are people in your contact list who need to hear this before midnight. God is about to release a wave of lastm minute miracles that will shock the medical world, confound economist and silence the mockers. Your testimony is loading. Your breakthrough is downloading. Your deliverance is being processed in the courts of heaven. Share this word quickly. Time is of the essence. Heaven is about to move. I greet you in the mighty name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Somebody shout hallelujah. >> Hallelujah. >> I want you to understand that the prayer you are about to pray is not an ordinary prayer. This is a violent prayer for a violent generation. This is a militant prayer for those who have been pushed to the wall. This is a prayer for those who have decided that enough is enough. I am talking to those who have made up their minds that they will not negotiate with the enemy anymore. You will not beg the devil for what belongs to you. You will not plead with darkness to release your portion. You will take it by force. Jesus made a profound statement in Matthew 11:12. He said, "From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force." Now, I want you to pay attention to the structure of that scripture. It says, "The kingdom of heaven suffers violence." That means there is a legitimate sanctioned heaven approved violence that believers must engage in. This is not physical violence. This is not carnal warfare. 2 Corinthians 10:4 tells us, "For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds." The violence we are talking about is spiritual militancy. It is aggressive faith. It is uncompromising prayer. It is the kind of desperation that makes you cry out until heaven responds. It is church. We are living in a season where the enemy has become increasingly bold. The spirit of delay has become brazen. The spirit of stagnation has become confident. The spirit of frustration has set up altars in families that should be blessed. There are believers who have prayed for years without seeing results. There are people who have decreed and declared, who have confessed and believed, but their situations have remained unchanged. And the question that burns in their hearts is why? Why has my breakthrough delayed? Why has my miracle tried? Why does it seem like my prayers are not being answered? Let me show you something from the book of Daniel chapter 10. Daniel had been praying and fasting for 21 days. He had touched heaven. He had alive himself with the will of God, but nothing was happening in the natural realm. No breakthrough, no manifestation, no visible result. And then on the 21st day an angel appeared to him. And this is what the angel said in verses 12 and 13. Fear not Daniel for from the first day that thou didest set thine heart to understand and to chasten thyself before thy God. Thy words were heard. And I am come for thy words. But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me 1 and 20 days. Do you see what happened? Daniel's prayer was heard from the first day. Heaven had already dispatched the answer. The angel was already on the way with Daniel's breakthrough. But there was resistance in the second heaven. There was a prince, a territorial spirit, a demonic principality that stood in the way and delayed the manifestation of what God had already released. This is the reality many believers are facing today. Your miracle has been released, but it is being contested. Your breakthrough has been dispatched, but it is being delayed. Your restoration has been decreed in heaven, but it is being resisted in the second heaven. And this is why you need violent prayer. This is why you need militant intercession. This is why you need to engage the enemy with the kind of aggression that says, "You will not hold my blessing any longer. You will not delay my manifestation any further." Ephesians 6:12 says, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. Your battle is not with people. Your battle is not with your employer, your spouse, your relatives, or your neighbors. Your battle is with powers and principalities that have set themselves against your destiny. And you cannot fight a spiritual battle with carnal weapons. You cannot fight territorial spirits with church attendance alone. You cannot dislodge principalities with religious activities. You need the fire of the Holy Ghost. You need the power of violent prayer. I decree and declare over your life right now, every demonic prince that has been assigned to withstand your breakthrough, I command that prince to fall right now in the name of Jesus. Every territorial spirit that has been contesting your miracle, let that spirit be paralyzed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every wicked personality in the second heaven that has been holding your blessings hostage, I command the angel of the Lord to strike them down in the mighty name of Jesus. Your season of delay is over. Your season of frustration is terminated. Your season of mockery has come to an end. From this moment forward, you are entering into a season of manifestation. Somebody shout, "It is my season. It is my time. It is my turn." The Lord is saying to someone under the sound of my voice, "I have seen your tears. I have heard your groaning. I have watched you pray when others were sleeping. I have observed your faithfulness when you had every reason to give up. And I am about to vindicate you. I am about to elevate you. I am about to bless you in such a way that your story will become a testimony that will strengthen the faith of millions. Now let us enter into the place of violent prayer. I want you to understand that this is not the time to pray polite prayers. This is not the time to pray lukewarm prayers. This is not the time to pray politically correct prayers. This is the time to pray with holy anger. This is the time to pray with righteous indignation. This is the time to look the enemy in the face and say, "You have gone too far. You have crossed the line. You have I decree and declare every altar speaking against me, catch fire now in the name of Jesus. Every evil priest ministering against my destiny, fall down and die in the name of Jesus. Every satanic ceremony conducted against my family, I scatter it by the blood of Jesus. Every evil prophecy uttered against my life, I nullify it by the power of the Holy Ghost, every demonic verdict issued against my progress, I reverse it by the authority of Jesus Christ. I am not a victim. I am a victor. I am not defeated. I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. Romans 8:37 says, "Nay, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him that loved us." You are not just a conqueror, you are more than a conqueror. That means you do not just win battles. You win them overwhelmingly. You win them decisively. You win them in such a way that the enemy cannot recover. I prophesy over your life, every battle you are fighting right now, you will not just win it. You will win it so completely that the enemy will never attempt to attack you in that area again. Father, I thank you for the life of everyone reading this word right now. I thank you because you are a God who answers prayer. You are a God who performs miracles. You are a God who does exceeding abundantly above all that we can ask or think according to the power that works in us. Ephesians 3:20 reminds us of this truth. Lord, we come before you not in our own righteousness but in the righteousness of Jesus Christ. We come before you not because we are worthy but because you have made us worthy through the blood of the lamb. We come before you with bold confidence because Hebrews 4:16 tells us to come boldly unto the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. Father, I lift up every person reading this prayer right now. I lift up their families, their careers, their businesses, their ministries, their health, their finances, their relationships, their destinies. Lord, there are people reading this who have been fighting battles that nobody knows about. There are people reading this who have been crying in secret. I decree and declare every stronghold in your mind be pulled down now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of depression I command you to leave now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of anxiety I cast you out now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of fear I rebuke you now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of discouragement, I bind you now in the name of Jesus. You will not weigh down the children of God. You will not oppress the beloved of the Lord. You will not torment those who have been purchased by the blood of Jesus. Isaiah 54:1 17 declares, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee shall be broken. thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. I claim this promise over your life right now. Every weapon that has been formed against you, I decree that it will not prosper. Every tongue that has risen against you in judgment, I decree that you will condemn it. Every evil word spoken against you, let it return to the sender sevenfold in the name of Jesus, every curse pronounced against you, let it be broken by the blood of Jesus, every hex, every spell, every enchantment, every divination, every witchcraft, every sorcery directed against you, let it be destroyed by fire In the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I pray for financial breakthrough. I pray for those who have been faithful in their giving but are struggling to make ends meet. I pray for those who have swn seeds but have not seen a harvest. I pray for those who have been diligent in their work but have not been promoted. Lord, you are Jehovah Gyra, the God who provides. You are El Shadai, the God who is more than enough. Philippians 4:1 19 says, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Father, I ask that you open the windows of heaven over the lives of your people. Release financial miracles that will leave them speechless. Bring opportunities that they never applied for. Connect them with people. Father, I pray for marriages that are under attack. I pray for homes that are on the verge of collapsing. I pray for couples who have lost the love they once had for each other. Lord, you instituted marriage. You ordained it in the Garden of Eden before sin ever entered the world. You said in Matthew chapter 19:6, "What therefore God had joined together, let not man put a sunder." Father, I ask that you restore every marriage that is reading this prayer. Heal every wound. Mend every breach. Revive every dying love. Remove every third-party interference. Destroy every spirit of lust, adultery, pornography, and perversion that is working against marriages. I decree and declare every demonic hand touching marriages be cut off by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of divorce, I bind you now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of misunderstanding, I cast you out now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of bitterness, I command you to leave now in the name of Jesus. Every external interference in marriages, I command it to be consumed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every strange woman, every strange man assigned to destroy marriages, I decree that their assignment will fail warfully in the name of Jesus. Love will be restored. Peace will return. Joy will be revived. Intimacy will be rekindled. Marriages will be stronger than they have ever been. Father, I pray for those who are believing you for the fruit of the womb. I pray for women who have been told they can never conceive. I pray for men who have been diagnosed with low sperm count or other medical conditions. I pray for couples who have tried everything without success. Lord, you are the God who opened the womb of Sarah, Hannah, Elizabeth, and many others. You are the God who specializes in impossibilities. Luke 1:37 says, "For with God nothing shall be impossible." Father, I ask that you visit every barren womb reading this prayer. Let there be conception by divine intervention. Let there be supernatural healing of every reproductive organ. Let there be a reversal of every medical report that contradicts your word. I decree and declare every spirit of Father, I pray for those who are battling sickness and disease. I pray for those who have been given negative medical reports. I pray for those who have been told their condition is incurable. I pray for those who have been suffering for years without relief. Lord, you are Jehovah Rafa, the God who heals. You said in Exodus 15 26, I am the Lord that health thee. Father, by the stripes of Jesus, we were healed. First Peter chapter 2:24 confirms this truth. I ask that you release healing power into everybody that is reading this prayer. Let there be supernatural restoration of organs. Let there be regeneration of tissues. Let there be divine adjustment of every system in the body. I decree and declare every infirmity in your body be healed now in the name of Jesus. Every sickness be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. Every disease be eradicated now in the name of Jesus. Every pain be removed now in the name of Jesus. Cancer, I command you to die now in the name of Jesus. Diabetes, I command you to live now in the name of Jesus. High blood pressure, I command you to be normalized now in the name of Jesus. Arthritis be healed now in the name of Jesus. Migraine be terminated now in the name of Jesus. Asthma be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. HIV be consumed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every genetic disorder be reversed now by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every organ that is not functioning properly, receive divine healing now in the name of Jesus. You are healed. You are whole. You are restored. You are completely recovered by the power of the blood of Jesus. Father, I pray for those who are facing legal battles. I pray for those who have been falsely accused. I pray for those who have been persecuted unjustly. I pray for those who have court cases that seem to be going against them. Lord, you are the righteous judge. You are the God who defends the innocent. Psalm 35 says, "Plead my cause, oh Lord, with them that strive with me. Fight against them." Father, I pray for those who are struggling with addictions. I pray for those who are bound by drugs, alcohol, pornography, gambling, and other vices. I pray for those who have tried to quit but keep falling back. I pray for those who feel hopeless and trapped. Lord, you are the deliverer. You are the breaker. You are the one who sets the captives free. John 8:36 says, "If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed." Father, I ask that you break every chain of addiction. Destroy every stronghold of the enemy. Release your power to set the captives free. I decree and declare every spirit of addiction be broken now in the name of Jesus. Every stronghold of the enemy in your mind be pulled down now in the name of Jesus. Every demonic covenant keeping you in bondage be destroyed by the blood of Jesus. every craving, every urge, every compulsion be consumed by fire in the name of Jesus. You are free. You are delivered. You are liberated. You are no longer a slave to sin. You are a child of God. You are redeemed. You are sanctified. You are purified by the blood of the lamb. Thus sayeth the spirit of the Lord. There is someone reading this prayer who has been at the point of committing suicide. You have felt like your life has no meaning. You have felt like you are a burden to everyone around you. You have felt like the pain is too much to bear. But the Lord says to you today, I have not forgotten you. I have not abandoned you. I have not forsaken you. Your life has purpose. Your life has meaning. Your life has destiny. The enemy has been lying to you. He has been telling you that things will never get better. He has been telling you that you should end it all. But I am here to tell you that the best days of your life are ahead of you. The breakthrough you have been waiting for is about to manifest. The healing you have been crying for is about to come. The deliverance you have been praying for is about to happen. Do not give up. Do not quit. Do not throw in the towel. Your miracle is on the way. I decree and declare every spirit of suicide be bound now. Father, I pray for those who are facing spiritual attacks in their dreams. I pray for those who experience nightmares, evil visitations, sexual dreams, and satanic manipulation while they sleep. Lord, you said in Psalm 127:E2, he giveth his beloved sleep. Father, I ask that you grant your children peaceful, restful, undisturbed sleep. Let there be angelic protection over their nights. Let there be divine covering over their dreams. I decree and declare every evil dream be cancelled now in the name of Jesus. Every nightmare be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic visitation in the night be terminated now in the name of Jesus. Every incubous and succubus spirit be consumed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit spouse I divorce you now by the blood of Jesus. Every evil plantation in your body through dreams be uprooted now in the name of Jesus. Every spiritual husband, every spiritual wife, I command you to release your victims now in the name of Jesus. Every covenant of the night be broken now by the power of the Holy Ghost. You will sleep in peace. You will wake up refreshed. You will have divine dreams. You will receive revelation in your sleep. Father, I pray for those who are facing challenges in their careers. I pray for those who have been stagnant in the same position for years. I pray for those who have been passed over for promotion repeatedly. I pray for those who are working below their qualifications. Lord, you are the God who promotes. You are the God who elevates. Psalm 75:6 and 7 says, "For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south, but God is the judge. He put it down one and set up another. Father, I ask that you promote your children. Open doors that no man can shut. Give them favor with those who have the power to elevate them. I decree and declare every spirit of stadulation in your career be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every evil hand holding you down. Father, I pray for students who are reading this prayer. I pray for those who are struggling academically. I pray for those who have exams coming up. I pray for those who feel overwhelmed by their studies. Lord, you are the source of all wisdom and knowledge. James 1:5 says, "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God that giveth to all men liberally and upgradeth not, and it shall be given him." Father, I ask that you grant students supernatural wisdom, knowledge, and understanding. Give them excellent memory. Give them the ability to understand difficult concepts. Give them favor with their teachers and examiners. I decree and declare every spirit of failure be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of confusion be cast out now in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of forgetfulness be bound now in the name of Jesus. Every evil mark placed on your academic destiny be erased by the blood of Jesus. You will excel. You will succeed. You will graduate with distinction. You will be the head of your class. You will receive scholarships. You will be awarded. You will be recognized. You will be celebrated. Father, I pray for those who have believing you for marital settlement. I pray for those who have been single for many years. I pray for those who have been in relationships that keep breaking down. I pray for those who are at an age where they feel forgotten. Lord, you know the desires of their heart. You know their longing for companionship. You know they are yearning for a godly spouse. Father, I ask that you connect them with their divine partners. Bring them together by supernatural orchestration. Remove every hindrance, every delay, every obstacle standing in the way of their marital settlement. I decree and declare every spirit of marital delay be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit spouse blocking your marriage be consumed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every evil covenant affecting your marriage be broken now by the blood of Jesus. Every wrong relationship be terminated now in the name of Jesus. Every destiny connection that the enemy has blocked. Thus sayeth the spirit of the Lord. There is someone reading this prayer who has been labeled a failure by your family. They have written you off. They have said you will never amount to anything. They have compared you to others and made you feel inadequate. But the Lord says to you today, their opinion of you is not my opinion of you. Their assessment of you is not my assessment of you. I see greatness in you. I see potential in you. I see glory in you. What they meant for evil, I will turn around for good. Where they said you will fail, you will succeed. Where they said you will be last, you will be first. Where they said you will be forgotten, you will be celebrated. I am about to surprise everyone who has underestimated you. I am about to shock everyone who has written you off. Get ready for the greatest comeback of your life. I decree and declare every negative label placed upon you be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every word cause spoken against you by family members be nullified now by the blood of Jesus. Every spirit of comparison be cast out now in the name of Jesus. Every limitation placed on you by people be broken now in the name of Jesus. You are not a failure. You are a success. You are not rejected. You are accepted in the beloved. You are not forgotten. You are remembered by God. You will arise. You will shine. You will excel. You will surpass expectations. You will break generational causes. You will set new standards. You will be the one who changes your family narrative. Father, I pray for those who have lost loved ones. I pray for those who are grieving. I pray for those who are struggling with the pain of loss. Lord, you are close to the brokenhearted. You are the God of all comfort. 2 Corinthians 1:3 and 4 says, "Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort, who comforted us in all our tribulation. Father, I ask that you comfort those who are mourning. Heal their broken hearts. I decree and declare every spirit of grief be lifted now in the name of Jesus. Every tormenting memory be healed now in the name of Jesus. Every pain be soothed now in the name of Jesus. You will find comfort. You will find peace. You will find strength. You will move forward. You will live again. You will laugh again. You will experience joy again. The Lord will restore the years that have been lost. The Lord will turn your mourning into dancing. The Lord will give you beauty for ashes. Father, I pray for those who are facing family conflicts. I pray for those who have been estranged from their loved ones. I pray for those who are dealing with toxic family relationships. I pray for those who feel isolated and rejected by their own blood. Lord, you are the God who restores. You are the God who reconciles. You are the God who heals broken relationships. Father, I ask that you bring peace to troubled families, soften hardened hearts, remove pride and unforgiveness, create an atmosphere of love and understanding. I decree and declare every spirit of division in your family be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of unforgiveness be cast out now in the name of Jesus. Every ancestral grudge be broken now by the blood of Jesus. Every evil pattern of family conflict be terminated now in the name of Jesus. Peace will reign in your family. Love will be restored in your family. Unity will return to your family. Reconciliation will manifest in your family. Your family will be healed. Your family will be whole. Your family will be blessed. Father, I pray for those who are in business. I pray for entrepreneurs who are struggling. I pray for business owners who are on the verge of collapse. I pray for those who have invested everything but are not seeing returns. Lord, you are the God who prospers. You are the God who multiplies. You are the God who gives the power to get wealth according to Deuteronomy 8:18. Father, I ask that you bless every business belonging to your children. Give them creative ideas. Connect them with the right clients and customers. pro. I decree and declare every spirit of business failure be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of loss be bound now in the name of Jesus. Every evil hand in your business be cut off now in the name of Jesus. Every wicked partner be exposed now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic manipulation of your business be terminated now in the name of Jesus. Every customer that the enemy has driven away return now in the name of Jesus. Every contract that has been blocked be released now in the name of Jesus. Your business will prosper. Your business will expand. Your business will be profitable. Your business will be a blessing to nations. Father, I pray for those who are in ministry. I pray for pastors, prophets, evangelists, teachers, and apostles who are facing challenges. I pray for those who have been attacked by the enemy. I pray for those who have been discouraged and are considering quitting. Lord, you called them. You anointed them. You commissioned them. Father, I ask that you strengthen them. Renew their passion. Restore their zeal. Protect them from the attacks of the enemy. Give them wisdom to navigate the complexities of ministry. I decree and declare every attack against your ministry be destroyed by fire in the name of Jesus. Every spirit of discouragement be cast out now in the name of Jesus. Every false accusation against your ministry be nullified now in the name of Jesus. Every conspiracy to shut down your ministry be scattered now in the name of Jesus. Every financial attack on your ministry be broken now in the name of Jesus. Your ministry will grow. Your ministry will expand. Your ministry will be fruitful. Your ministry will touch nations. You will fulfill your calling. You will complete your assignment. You will hear the Lord say, "Well done, good and faithful servant. Thus saith the spirit of the Lord." There is someone reading this prayer who has been dealing with a stubborn situation. You have prayed about it. You have fasted about it. You have decreed about it. But nothing seems to be changing. The Lord says to you today, do not be weary in welloing. I decree and declare every stubborn situation in your life, receive divine intervention now in the name of Jesus. Every problem that has refused to go, be dissolved now by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every mountain that has refused to move, be cast into the sea now in the name of Jesus. Every door that has refused to open, be opened now by the key of David. Every battle that has refused to end, be won now by the captain of the host. Your situation will change. Your problem will be solved. Your mountain will be removed. Your door will be opened. Your battle will be won. Victory is yours. Breakthrough is yours. Deliverance is yours. Father, I pray for those who are dealing with ancestral causes. I pray for those who have patterns in their family that keep repeating. I pray for those who feel like they are fighting battles that their parents and grandparents fought. Lord, you said in Galatians 3:13, "Christ has redeemed us from the cause of the law. being made a cause for us. Father, I declare that every ancestral c is broken by the blood of Jesus. Every generational bondage is destroyed by the power of the cross. Every evil pattern is terminated by the resurrection power of Christ. I decree and declare every ancestral curse in your bloodline be broken now by the blood of Jesus. Every generational bondage be destroyed now by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every evil covenant working in your family be nullified now in the name of Jesus. Every pattern of poverty be terminated now in the name of Jesus. Every pattern of sickness be destroyed now in the name of Jesus. Every pattern of untimely death be broken now in the name of Jesus. Every pattern of failure be eradicated now in the name of Jesus. You are free. Your children are free. Your children's children are free. The cause is broken. The cycle is broken. The pattern is broken. You are starting a new lineage of blessings. Father, I pray for those who have enemies plotting against them. I pray for those who have people who are jealous of them and want to see them fall. I pray for those who are facing opposition from every side. Lord, you said in Psalm 23:5, "Thou prepareest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies. Thou anointest my head with oil my cup runth over." Father, I ask that you expose every hidden enemy, disgrace every visible enemy, confuse every plot and plan of the enemy. I decree and declare every enemy of your destiny receive divine judgment now in the name of Jesus. Every jealous person working against you be disgraced now in the name of Jesus. Every evil plot be exposed now in the name of Jesus. Every wicked plan be frustrated now in the name of Jesus. Every trap set for you, catch the one who set it in the name of Jesus. Every arrow fired at you, return to sender sevenfold in the name of Jesus. Every evil arrow in your body, come out now by fire in the name of Jesus. You are untouchable. You are unreachable. You are protected. You are covered. You are shielded. No weapon formed against you will prosper. Father, I pray for those who are facing identity crisis. I pray for those who do not know who they are in Christ. I pray for those who are struggling with low selfesteem and lack of confidence. Lord, your word says in Psalm 139:14, I will praise thee.
